items.html: *Now, the aspect of Malchut revealed by herself is not found in Arich Anpin, only in the aspect of the crown of the Yesod in it, for all of this is male, but an actual female is not found. Likewise, in Atik Yomin, the aspect of female by itself is not found; only the crown of the Yesod of Atik is female, as in Arich Anpin. However, afterward, Malchut is revealed from the secret of that Reisha Ila’a of them all that is not known, which is called Atik Yomin, which is above all these nine Sefirot of Arich Anpin.
